text: Started: mobile page-scroll bug. Reading CSS/JS, will measure scrollHeight vs innerHeight on Pixel 5 in each overlay state.

Root cause candidate found. site.css:7 sets html{overflow-x:clip}, so html is not 'visible in both axes' and .page-board body{overflow:hidden !important} NEVER propagates to the viewport. Measured on Pixel 5: dropped a 2000px spacer in body, window.scrollTo(0,500) -> scrollY=500. The board page IS scrollable; it only looks fine because nothing usually exceeds 100vh.

Reproduced, 3/3 runs. Pixel 5 + real CDP touch, document 56px taller than innerHeight (what height:100vh gives on Chrome Android with the URL bar showing). Flick past the end of a markdown note: page scrolls 56px, three times out of three. The shortcuts card is immune because it sets overscroll-behavior:contain; .bd-markdown-body does not, so the gesture chains to the document. With html:has(body.page-board){overflow:hidden} injected: 0,0,0. Note still scrolls its own text (125px), board still pans and pinches 1.0 -> 2.8.

Done. One-line hunk in .tmp/scratch/opus5-34/patch.json: add overflow:hidden to the html:has(body.page-board) rule in CSS/braindump.css. Anchor verified unique (1 occurrence) and applying it reproduces the mirror byte-for-byte. New suite tests/board/mobile-page-scroll.test.mjs (port 4334, 7 cases) fails on current code with 'C: flicking past the end of a note must not scroll the page, got scrollY 56', fails an unscoped fix at case G, fails a blanket touchmove preventDefault at case C, and passes 3/3 with the hunk. 9 regression suites green in the mirror. Server on 4304 stopped. Open question for the user in notes.md: whether 100vh should also become 100dvh (I could not measure it, emulation has no URL bar). Unrelated: 15 orphan files in content/boards/cosmoboard/ written at 22:01-22:03Z, 20 min before I started, not mine.
